scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:html
scripts.build:css: npm run purgecss && npm run minify:css
scripts.minify:css: cleancss -o dist/css/styles.min.css styles.purged.css && cleancss -o dist/css/multi-page.min.css multi-page.css
scripts.minify:js: terser app.js -o dist/js/app.min.js && terser optimizations.js -o dist/js/optimizations.min.js
